newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson wins 650 mln SKR Portugal deal.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson wins 650 mln SKR Portugal deal.

text.p: Swedish telecoms giant LM Ericsson AB on Monday said it had won a 650 million crown contract with Portugal's Telecel to supply GSM infrastructure over the years 1997-99.
The contract includes switching, radio base stations and services, Ericsson said in a statement.
Ericsson said this built on the current relationship between Telecel and Ericsson.
Telecel Comunicacoes Pessoais SA is the private GSM operator in Portugal with commercial service since October 1992.
The main owners of Telecel are Grupo Esprito Santo, Grupo Amorim and AirTouch International.
The Telecel GSM network was expected to have 300,000 subscribers by the end of this year.
